The coordinates are Wikipedia's point for the whole 152-acre Central Park (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Central_Park_(Kolkata)), not for the ground itself. The 2027 Book Fair allotment was not yet confirmed in news reports.

No official venue page, size or coordinates found.

name: Dubai Airshow Site
address: Dubai World Central (DWC), Dubai

name: Dubai Exhibition Centre
aliases: Dubai Exhibition Centre, Expo City Dubai
address: Expo City Dubai (next to Expo 2020 Metro Station), Dubai
capacity_note: Phase 1 (delivered early 2026): 140,000 sqm purpose-built indoor event space, 50,000 visitors/day. Phase 2: 160,000 sqm, ~60,000/day. Full build-out 2031: 180,000 sqm, 65,000/day, 20+ simultaneous events

Also hosts GISEC, Middle East Coatings Show, CABSAT, Automechanika Dubai and World Art Dubai (DWTC press, 19 Aug 2026). The DWTC events page covers both venues. No DEC-specific coordinates found.

name: Dubai Harbour
address: 24883 Dubai
notes: Waterfront marina district, not a permanent exhibition hall. Hosts the annual Dubai International Boat Show (25-29 Nov 2026, per dubaiharbour.com/events); this is its only listed trade show. Its site lists Marinas on +971 (0)4 208 9222. The EventsEye URL dubaiharbour.com/en now returns 404.

At DWTC in H2 2026: Arabian Travel Market, Beautyworld Dubai, WETEX, Gulfood Manufacturing, Big 5 Global (DWTC press, 19 Aug 2026). Maps link from dwtc.com/en/contact/.

EventsEye lists Professional Beauty GCC and GVF Global Vertical Farming Fair. The EventsEye website field is a Facebook page.
